claim_one_line: MAIN AUDITS ITS NEGATIVES (the owner's P-152; GENESIS v1.46): every sealed instrument re-run reproduces and the independent routes agree -- the over-reading is in wording and propagation. Five features were booked as failures (B1644's exact zero, B1642's rank-two coupling read as 'no flavour structure', B1635's golden discovery, B1628's TM1 at 0.85 sigma, B1603's widespread generation shapes); tau = omega was retired on a near-omega clause with no cell, in a frame with the inner automorphisms (on the ruled branch the residual at omega is cyclic of order 12 with three distinct charges), and the isotropic Higgs directions were never tested as vacua; restrictions were worded as walls (B1646's 'never between' is quartic: an octic term or the zero modes' own one-loop term gives minima between; B1615/B1616 four elements; B1620 'none compatible with the data'; B1651 a point or density Higgs; B1652 'not shown'); corrections stopped at claim lines (GENESIS FK14's withdrawn carrier, B1637 in the registry, B1653's 'explains W72', B1648's coverage, CLOSED_DOORS' B1632); cells that could not fail were shown as tests, B1604's lock ended 'or True', and the retraction sweep cannot read two of its tables. Repaired on GENESIS, 24 verdict files, 24 FINDINGS, the six public refresh blocks, the outside-review page, THE_WEAVE, LAW_MAP, THEOREM_REGISTRY, the kill graph and one lock; E89 named; P-153 to P-161 rowed. 0 of 19.
